title: Streak Metrics Playbook — biweekly KPI scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick, low-friction log to keep a running streak of small wins and leading indicators that feed my OKR planning. Not meant as formal report — raw, punchy, and actionable.

How I use this doc:
- 10–15 min twice/week update (Mon + Thu)
- capture micro-metrics that compound (reviews done, experiments merged, follow-ups sent)
- surface blockers and decisions for 1:1s and async syncs

Current high-level objective alignment:
- Objective A: Improve inference reliability & predictability for hosted customers
  - KR1 (team): reduce 95p request latency by 15% on mGPT-family flows by end Q2
  - KR2 (me): land two kernel-level improvements that reduce worst-case token latency spikes

Biweekly streak snapshot (this cycle: 2026-02-18 -> 2026-03-03)
- daily small wins: 9/10 code review days with at least one PR reviewed
- PRs opened: 3 (batching heuristic + async-kv-fix + observability-event-tagging)
- PRs merged: 2 (batching heuristic; observability-event-tagging)
- Experiments launched: 1 (adaptive-batch-window, A/B on chat-2k traces)
- Observability signals improved: added a 95p spike tag to trace spans for quick filters (INF-3421)
- Customer issues triaged: 1 (priority: customer-42 slow startup cold-cache)

Quantitative delta vs last cycle
- median latency for sample trace: -4%
- 95p latency: -1% (no full impact yet — need kernel change merged)
- infra cost estimate change: +0.3% due to increased batching memory

Hypotheses I want to test next 2 weeks:
1) smaller, more frequent micro-batches reduce 95p spikes for long sequences when KV eviction happens — test via A/B on chat-2k with cache-size variations
2) moving a small part of tokenization off the critical path (local thread pool) reduces per-request jitter — bench and small prod canary

Action items (prioritized)
- [P0] Finish kernel patch for attention-kv-guard (PR to runtime) — owner: me — due: 2026-03-12 — blockers: need SRE perf harness time
- [P1] Add automated dashboard for 'streak' metrics (reviews/day, experiments launched) — owner: Nina — due: 2026-03-20 — linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287
- [P2] Schedule 30-min sync with infra to reserve perf cluster (mention INF-3421) — owner: me — done: requested 2026-03-02
- [P3] Draft short postmortem template for recurring small regressions — owner: me — due: 2026-03-16

Blockers / open questions:
- Perf harness availability windows are clashing with other teams; can SRE carve out 2h next Tue? (pinged via #sre-runbook)
- Is the 15% 95p target for mGPT family realistic without quantization changes? Need product context.
- Should I prioritize kernel-level fix (longer lead) vs. batching heuristic (faster iteration)? Suggested: kernel-first if we can secure perf cluster.

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep the streak small: 3 micro-goals per week is sustainable.
- Don't let PR perfection paralysis stall the kernel patch; ship an iterative patch.
- Follow up with PM on customers asking for 'predictable latency' — ask for concrete SLOs.

Quick weekly check-ins (log)
- 2026-02-22 (Mon): Quick sync w/ Nina. Agreed: land logging tag, she will prototype dashboard tiles. PR review: batching heuristic (LGTM).
- 2026-02-25 (Thu): Kernel patch prototype stalls on CI flakiness — need SRE test env. Opened INF-3421.
- 2026-03-01 (Mon): Canary started for adaptive-batch-window on 5% traffic. Initial metrics: median down 3%, 95p unchanged.

Personal growth & non-product goals
- Mentor 1 new intern this quarter — check-ins every Tues 30m.
- Prepare lightning talk for infra summit: topic 'practical streak metrics for engineers' — draft due 2026-03-21.
- Spend 1 hour/wk on writing (post about batching heuristics).

End-of-cycle reflection (short)
- What went well: kept streak of reviews, launched a focused experiment, formalized an observable tag for quick triage.
- What didn't: kernel patch stalled; need earlier SRE coordination and smaller incremental CI-friendly patches.
- Next cycle focus: unblock kernel perf testing, iterate on batching A/B, and make 'streak dashboard' a reality.

References/links (quick):
- INF-3421: perf harness + kernel patch tracking
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287
- Slack: #eng-serving-runtime, thread "latency-95p-initiative"

TODO (tiny):
- Add a one-line summary at top for weekly digest automation.
- Turn 'streak' metrics into a tiny JSON blob the dashboard can consume.

-- E.B.
